BHARAT DUHAN 📞 8851518364 | ✉️ bharatduhan4@gmail.com | 🔗 linkedin.com/in/bharat-duhan-62777b167 | 📍 Bengaluru, India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Network Development Engineer with 4+ years of experience engineering and automating hyperscale data center networks (10,000+ devices) across Oracle Cloud (OCI), Juniper Networks, and Cisco environments. Expert in BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, MPLS, and Python-driven network automation. Proven track record of reducing operational overhead by 95% and resolving critical P1/P2 architecture bottlenecks. Recognized with corporate awards for technical excellence and rapid professional advancement.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Protocols & Fabrics:

BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, EVPN, VXLAN, MC-LAG, STP, VTP, Segment Routing, ARP, DNS, DHCP

Hardware & Platforms: Cisco Nexus/Catalyst, Juniper MX/PTX/ACX/QFX/EX series, Palo Alto Networks Firewalls

Automation & DevOps: Python (Netmiko, Paramiko), Ansible, REST APIs, Git version control, CI/CD pipelines

Telemetry & Systems: Grafana, Zabbix, gNMI telemetry, Linux/Unix system administration, AWS Networking

Fundamentals

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) — Network Developer Engineer II

Nov 2025 – Present



Engineer and certify next-generation hyperscale AI and cloud data center network deployments spanning 10,000+ active devices and multi-thousand rack topologies.



Architected a Python-based network validation automation framework, reducing pre-production testing cycles by 97% (from over 10 hours down to 15 minutes).



Perform end-to-end continuous validation of BGP, OSPF, EVPN, VXLAN, and multi-tier fabric connectivity to eliminate production-impacting regressions.



Leverage Grafana, Zabbix, and gNMI telemetry data to construct high-visibility operational dashboards, improving deployment reliability across global regions.



Debug and resolve complex EVPN/VXLAN fabric routing anomalies in cross-functional collaboration with SRE, Cloud Infrastructure, and DevOps teams.

Juniper Networks — Technical Support Engineer II

Dec 2023 – Oct 2025



Spearheaded root-cause analysis and resolution for 300+ enterprise and service provider support cases, including over 100 high-severity P1/P2 production network outages.



Restored critical production environments and core fabric infrastructure for Tier-1 healthcare and transportation customers across Europe during live infrastructure crises.



Partnered directly with Core Engineering teams to reproduce hardware/software defects, validate hotfixes, and drive rapid software defect resolution.



Promoted ahead of schedule (2024) and honored as Employee of the Year (2025) for exceptional technical leadership and global customer impact.

Page 1 of 2

Capgemini (Cisco TAC) — Associate Engineer

Jan 2022 – Nov 2023



Delivered enterprise-level Tier-3 TAC technical support for global Cisco Catalyst switching and ISR/ASR routing portfolios.



Diagnosed complex Layer 2/Layer 3 infrastructure failures including spanning-tree loops, VTP misconfigurations, ARP storms, and DHCP exhaustion issues.



Executed high-risk production software upgrades, disaster recovery procedures (ROMMON), and comprehensive end-to-end troubleshooting for Fortune 500 networks.



Collaborated closely with engineering units to reproduce software bugs and validate production-ready patches.

KEY PROJECTS

Network Validation Automation Framework (Python, Netmiko, Git)



Designed and scaled a multi-vendor automation framework that reduced device pre-production validation time from 10 hours to 15 minutes, standardizing configurations across hyperscale environments.

Large-Scale Multi-Vendor Upgrade Orchestrator (Ansible, Python)



Built an automated orchestration framework capable of safely deploying OS upgrades across 1,000+ distributed Juniper routing and switching devices simultaneously while minimizing localized downtime windows.

Automated Log Analysis & Fault-Correlation Engine (Python, Regex)



Developed log parsing and fault-correlation tooling to ingest real-time device syslog data, cutting down average troubleshooting and root-cause discovery times by 40%.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering

Punjab Technical University (Graduated 2021)

Professional Certifications: AWS Cloud Fundamentals | JNCIS | JNCIA | PCNSA | CCNA

Page 2 of 2

Network Validation Automation Framework (Python, Netmiko, Git)

Designed and scaled a multi-vendor automation framework that reduced device pre-production validation time from 10 hours to 15 minutes, standardizing configurations across hyperscale environments.
Large-Scale Multi-Vendor Upgrade Orchestrator (Ansible, Python)

Built an automated orchestration framework capable of safely deploying OS upgrades across 1,000+ distributed Juniper routing and switching devices simultaneously while minimizing localized downtime windows.
Automated Log Analysis & Fault-Correlation Engine (Python, Regex)

Developed log parsing and fault-correlation tooling to ingest real-time device syslog data, cutting down average troubleshooting and root-cause discovery times by 40%.
